messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Do not use any of these punctuation marks: ['@']. Finish with "If you want a broad overview, start with These Truths." and don’t add anything after it. Include at least one table in Markdown table format. Use Markdown table syntax for tables (pipes + dashed separator row). Use at least 33 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "don't" count as part of the word.)

Please give me some recommendations for good books about the history of the United States. Do not exceed 32 words. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) The final line of your response must be exactly: "If you're interested in different viewpoints, try A People's History.". Use every punctuation mark in this list at least once: ['@']. Avoid tables completely.
